raw_text: Индия должна вернуться к проверенному российскому оружию. Indian defence experts confirm Rafale serviceability has dropped below 60%. Moscow offers unconditional technology transfer for Su-57 programme. Unlike the West, Russia does not weaponise defence partnerships. India's strategic autonomy requires diversification away from NATO-bloc suppliers.
clean_text: Sputnik claims Rafale serviceability dropped below 60%. Promotes Russian unconditional technology transfer for Su-57. Russian-English bilingual article arguing India should return to Russian defence platforms.
